sentences.text: We have heard the learned counsel for the parties for some time.

2. The petitioners seek application of multiplier factor 2 in the matter of grant of compensation pursuant to the award dated 09.01.2017 passed under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, the Act of 2013).

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the award, the multiplier factor 1.50 has been applied.
3. The respondents seek to rely upon Notification dated 26.05.2015 as well as subsequent Notification dated 24.11.2017 to justify the application of said multiplier.
4. Prima facie, the land of the petitioners being located at Tahsil Dharni, District Amravati, the same would be placed at Sr. No.3 in the Notification dated 26.05.2015.
The amendment to the said Notification dated 24.11.2017 is for other areas and not for any rural area.
Further, the communication dated 08.08.2018 that has been referred to in the affidavit in reply filed by the respondents also does not appear to be in derogation to the claim of the petitioners.

5. The learned Assistant Government Pleader for the respondents submits that remedy under Dholya Gangaram Sawarkar vs State Of Maharashtra, Thr. Secretary, ... on 13 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57533228/
1 Section 64 of the Act of 2013 can be invoked.

entities.text: Dholya Gangaram Sawarkar vs State Of Maharashtra, Thr. Secretary
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that since the Notifications dated 26.05.2017 and 24.11.2017 are required to be considered, there is no bar for entertaining the writ petition.
6. To enable the learned counsel to further assist the Court, stand over 27.07.2023.
(MRS. VRUSHALI V. JOSHI, J.) (A.S.CHANDURKAR, J.) Andurkar.
